samples.title: Humanity, in motion
samples.blurb: Eight letters fly in, breathe, and pull apart to find the unity hidden inside the word.

samples.title: Particle field
samples.blurb: Thousands of glass sparks drift on a flow field and gather around your cursor or finger.

samples.title: The mark, assembling
samples.blurb: The TJ-Hosting mark builds itself from scanlines and a turning globe. Press replay.

samples.title: The split-flap board
samples.blurb: A navy departures board that flips letter by letter, row by row, with room for your own line.

samples.title: Star-trail text
samples.blurb: Words appear along curved lines behind a trail of cyan and white stars, then the whole sequence plays again.

samples.title: Glitch headline
samples.blurb: Type your own word and watch it tear into sliced cyan and royal copies for a moment, then copy the CSS that did it.

samples.title: Coral Ink Reactor
samples.blurb: Blue ink grows into coral, stripes and spots by itself, and you can drag to paint more.

samples.title: Slime Network
samples.blurb: Thousands of tiny agents leave glowing trails and grow a living network of veins between pulsing food spots.

samples.title: Breathing Contour Map
samples.blurb: A light topographic map that slowly breathes, with a hill that rises where you point.

samples.title: Ink Tide GPU Fluid
samples.blurb: Cyan and blue ink swirls through dark water where you drag, and a ghost finger keeps it moving when you don't.

samples.title: The scroll tunnel
samples.blurb: Glass tiles of hosting words fly past as you scroll, until a glowing tile marked Your site settles in the middle.

samples.title: Glass Card Flow
samples.blurb: A fanned row of glass cards, each a tiny website drawn in CSS, that turn to face you as they reach the middle.

samples.title: Tear the glass curtain
samples.blurb: A frosted curtain sways over a message: pull it until it tears, slice it open, or part it with one click.

samples.title: Magnetic dot mesh
samples.blurb: A lattice of blue dots springs away from your pointer, ripples when you tap and flows around a glass headline card.

samples.title: The brand colour sphere
samples.blurb: A turning sphere of colour patches around a base colour you pick: tints, shades and neighbouring hues. Click a patch to copy its hex.

samples.title: Integration beams
samples.blurb: A site tile joined to six glass tiles by curved beams of cyan and royal light, each tile pulsing as a beam lands.

samples.title: Living Glass Bento Grid
samples.blurb: Six frosted tiles for hosting services, each with a small looping drawing, that lift on hover and slide up a Learn more bar.

samples.title: Clock Wall
samples.blurb: Your local time drawn by about a hundred small glass clocks whose hands turn into the digits, with a wave every minute.

exhibits.title: The Agent Honeypot
exhibits.blurb: A motion piece about humanity that also carries harmless hidden instructions aimed at AI agents. Each one asks only for a short poem. Ask your AI assistant to summarise it, then check whether it obeyed, flagged or ignored them.
